title: capsella bursa-pastoris prionophylla
intro: Capsella bursa-pastoris prionophylla, commonly known as Shepherd's purse, is a flowering plant in the mustard family, characterized by its heart-shaped seed pods. The plant is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include treating conditions such as heavy menstrual bleeding, postpartum hemorrhage, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Shepherd's purse are attributed to its ability to promote blood clotting, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
